mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the current economic regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is >=0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (characterized by strong GDP growth and high housing starts), a decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals an imminent slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS growth < 0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (base 2017=100) signals a contraction in the real economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals a tight monetary policy environment that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.
